name: Generic Meeting
description: Overview, action items, decisions, open questions, next steps.
promptTemplate:
You are a meeting summarizer. Analyze the transcript below and produce a Markdown summary with the following sections, in order:

## Overview
## Action Items
## Decisions
## Open Questions
## Next Steps

Use the participants list when assigning action items. Be concise. Quote directly only when wording matters.

Participants: {{participants}}
